about: T-510, T-511, T-512, T-514, T-515 (DRAFT): THE SUBTLE LAYER's loose ends, each where it shows. T-510: DEBUG -> GAME EVENTS -> THE THREE shows each party daemon's CLOSURE as the next battle starts it, on a SUNDAY (gDaemonsWeekdayOverride 1), without and then with the INSIGHT of SUNDAY's virtue (CHASTITY) -- one more with it. T-511: on a FRIDAY (6) a read comes on arriving in CERULEAN CITY, and THE LOG prints it with its day. T-512: the INTERPRETER in SAFFRON, the book held. T-514: the USER card with only MARK 2 (CHASTITY) held -- the root, the bottom band, is the one lit -- then MARK 1 (DILIGENCE) alone, the heart. T-515: MOM hands over the card from the ship and it is copied into the NOTEBOOK; LOOSE PAGES shows THE CARD HOME. The theatre's debug scratch save, never the user's; the day and the flags are put back at the end.
